units.source_text: 一只眼睛的老人家第三次来到杜子春跟前，又说了跟从前不无二致的话。

en.t: The one-eyed old man came before Toshishun for the third time and again said words almost no different from before.

units.source_text: 不用多说，此时杜子春正迷惘的站在洛阳西城门下，望着天空中一弯新月拨云见月，洒满光辉。

en.t: Needless to say, at that moment Toshishun was standing in bewilderment beneath the western gate of Luoyang, looking up as a slender new moon emerged from the clouds and filled the sky with light.
